title: Phase D mock-ups — pick a chip design and a terminal backing
_note: Nothing here ships. Two questions, one pick each: which attachment chip, which terminal backing. 'None of these' + a note if none fits.

steps.headline: Which attachment chip should the composer use? Click a picture or a button; add a note if you want a mix.
steps.notice: All three show the same eleven files (image, markdown, text, code, PDF, spreadsheet, audio, video, zip, a long name, unknown), then the same row at phone width. Text previews use canned lines; the real version would read the file's first lines.

variants.label: Wide chip
variants.summary: One-line pill: type icon, name cut after 16 letters (full name on hover), ✕ always visible. No preview.
variants.measured: 28 px tall; 6 of 11 fit before the row scrolls

variants.label: Card with name strip
variants.summary: Your direction: preview on top (thumbnail, first lines, or a big type glyph), name in an 11 px strip along the bottom, ✕ always visible.
variants.risk: ✕ overlaps the first preview line; the row is 72 px tall vs 48 today.

variants.label: Bigger card
variants.summary: B one size up so the preview is actually readable; name strip 12 px.
variants.measured: 128 × 96 px; 3 cards fit at phone width
variants.risk: Twice today's row height; the composer pushes the chat up noticeably.

steps.headline: How solid should the terminal's backing be under a wallpaper theme? Midnight is the flat reference — identical in all four.
steps.notice: The strip above the terminal never changes. The sample screen is canned Claude Code output, not a live session.

variants.label: Today
variants.summary: Text at 60% opacity straight over the blurred wallpaper — the theme's default.

variants.label: Stronger scrim
variants.summary: Same look, the terminal drawn at 85% instead of 60%.
variants.risk: A busy wallpaper (Halftone) still competes with small text.

variants.label: Panel, 90% solid
variants.summary: The theme's panel colour at 90%, the guarantee chat panels already have; a hint of wallpaper remains.
variants.risk: Meadow Mist's hand-made terminal backdrop is replaced by the flat panel colour.

variants.label: Panel, fully solid
variants.summary: A fully opaque panel — no wallpaper inside the terminal.
variants.risk: Wallpaper packs lose their character in Terminal view.
